Description: Few hotspots detected, possibly isolated defects, but could still impact critical circuit regions. Hotspots are relatively large (>50nm), requiring additional Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) adjustments. Total hotspot area exceeds 5000nm², which could affect lithography imaging quality and overall manufacturing yield. Hotspots are randomly distributed without clear patterns, indicating scattered defect points. Hotspot orientation is random, likely related to process errors or etching deviations. These hotspots may be caused by lithography resolution limits, particularly in 193nm Deep Ultraviolet (DUV) lithography technology. Variations in photoresist thickness could exacerbate exposure deviations in some hotspot areas, leading to non-uniform imaging effects.
